name: J B Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals Ltd
about: J.B. Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals Limited, established in 1976, is one of India's leading pharmaceutical companies. An integrated, publicly-listed organization with a focus on supplying affordable, quality products both in India and internationally, JBCPL is trusted by healthcare professionals globally. [1]
keyPoints: Change in Management[1] Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd. acquired control of the company through share purchase agreements executed in Jun and Jul'25, followed by an open offer under SEBI takeover regulations. The acquisition was completed in Jan and Feb'26, after which Torrent Pharma became the promoter of the company with a 48.8% equity stake as of Mar'26.
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 40.3%
Promoter holding has increased by 1.25% over last quarter.
cons: Stock is trading at 9.30 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -5.06%
Working capital days have increased from 86.6 days to 126 days
